**Chosen one-shot formulation:**

- **Ethanol:** **50.0 v/v%**
- **SDS:** **0.75 w/v%**

**Rationale:** The best valid result so far was around `34.6% ethanol / 0.75% SDS → 68.1°`, still ~3° above target. Since increasing ethanol has generally been the strongest lever for lowering contact angle, and `0.75% SDS` performed better than nearby higher-SDS points in the clean campaign, I would keep SDS near that best-performing level and push ethanol to the corrected upper feasible bound. My best one-shot estimate is therefore **50% ethanol + 0.75% SDS**, which is the most plausible candidate to land near **65°**.
